lines.name: The Thieves Guild
lines.about: The Thieves Guild is a guild of thieves based in the Ragged Flagon and the Cistern under Riften, and its story has you rise through the guild while it searches for a hidden enemy. The main story runs eleven quests, from A Chance Arrangement to Darkness Returns, with city jobs, collection quests and radiant jobs for Vex and Delvin Mallory around it.

getIn.how: Talk to Brynjolf in Riften; he talks you into one of his schemes and tells you to meet him during the day.

order.what: You steal Madesi's Silver Ring and plant it for Brynjolf.
You find Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon and collect three debts for the guild from Keerava, Bersi and Haelga.
You meet Mercer Frey, the Guild Master, and are sent to burn three bee hives and empty Aringoth's safe at Goldenglow Estate.
order.where: the Cistern under Riften and Goldenglow Estate, just outside Riften

order.what: Maven Black-Briar sends you to ruin Honningbrew Meadery near Whiterun.
order.where: Black-Briar Manor in Riften and Honningbrew Meadery near Whiterun

order.what: Mercer sends you to Solitude to make Gulum-Ei tell you who is working against the guild.
You meet Mercer outside Snow Veil Sanctum to hunt down Karliah.
Karliah needs Gallus' journal read, which sends you to Enthir at the College of Winterhold and then to Markarth.
order.where: the College of Winterhold and Understone Keep in Markarth

order.what: You meet Karliah at the Ragged Flagon, convince the guild, and break into Riftweald Manor for Mercer's plans.
order.where: the Ragged Flagon and Riftweald Manor in Riften

order.what: Karliah takes you and Brynjolf to Nightingale Hall, where you take the Oath and become a Nightingale.
You go after Mercer Frey in Irkngthand.
You take the Skeleton Key back to the Twilight Sepulcher alone and choose your Nightingale role.
Only if you break one of the guild's rules and are banned: you pay Vex to be let back in.
order.needs: Be banned for breaking a guild rule

order.what: Picking up an Unusual Gem starts it; you bring the Stones of Barenziah to Vex to rebuild a crown.
order.where: the Ragged Flagon, and wherever the stones lie across Skyrim
order.needs: An Unusual Gem, and full guild membership before Vex will look at it

order.what: Brynjolf offers you the post of Guild Master and holds the ceremony in the Cistern.
A radiant guild job from Vex: steal a named item from a wealthy home. The town and target are picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Vex: plant evidence in a wealthy home. The town and target are picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Delvin Mallory: forge the ledger at a business. The town and business are picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Delvin Mallory: pickpocket a named item from a mark. The mark is picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Vex: clear a house of three valuables. The house and city are picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Delvin Mallory: steal 500 gold worth of goods in a city without being seen. The city is picked when the job starts.
A radiant guild job from Vex: steal a named item from a business. The item, business and city are picked when the job starts.
Endon the silversmith in Markarth has asked the guild to get his stolen silver mold back.
Erikur in Solitude has asked the guild to frame the captain of the Dainty Sload.
Olfrid Battle-Born in Whiterun has asked the guild to free his friend Arn from jail.
order.where: the House of Clan Battle-Born and Dragonsreach in Whiterun

order.what: Torsten Cruel-Sea in Windhelm has asked the guild to recover his dead daughter's locket from a rival guild.
order.where: Windhelm and Uttering Hills Cave, Eastmarch

order.what: A journal pointer telling you to talk to Brynjolf in Riften about joining the guild.
You learn about the guild from Vex and Delvin Mallory and collect your Thieves Guild armor from Tonilia.
Tonilia sends you to deliver Moon Sugar to Ri'saad of the Khajiit caravans.
Finding one of the listed treasures, such as the queen bee statue in Goldenglow Estate, adds it to your journal; you hand each one to Delvin Mallory.
Glover Mallory in Raven Rock asks you to recover the Bonemold Formula.
order.where: Raven Rock and Castle Karstaag Caverns, Solstheim

options: Nightingale Strife
Nightingale Subterfuge
Shadowcloak of Nocturnal
Gulum-Ei talks once you have leverage on him
Gulum-Ei can't be made to talk, and the journal sends you to another source

gives: Membership in the Thieves Guild (Loud and Clear)
Thieves Guild Cuirass, Gloves, Boots and Hood from Tonilia (Meet the Family)
An enchanted one-handed weapon (Dampened Spirits)
Nightingale Hood, Nightingale Armor, Nightingale Gloves and Nightingale Boots, and the rank of Nightingale (Trinity Restored)
Nightingale Agent, one Nightingale power of your choice and the Nightingale Shadow Perk (Darkness Returns)
The title of Guild Master, the Guild Master Hood, Cuirass, Gloves and Boots, the Amulet of Articulation and the key to the Guild Master's Tribute Chest (Under New Management)
Prowler's Profit (No Stone Unturned)
Influential allies for the guild in Markarth, Solitude, Whiterun and Windhelm (the four city jobs)
closes: Sabjorn is jailed and Honningbrew Meadery closes; Mallus Maccius takes it over (Dampened Spirits)
Mercer Frey dies (Blindsighted)
The Skeleton Key is returned to the Ebonmere and leaves your inventory (Darkness Returns)
Linwe dies and the Summerset Shadows are gone from Skyrim (Summerset Shadows)
Breaking one of the guild's rules gets you banned until you pay in Reparations

the records place Brynjolf outdoors in Riften but not at a stall or spot, and his daily schedule isn't in the files

who hands out the four city jobs (Silver Lining, The Dainty Sload, Imitation Amnesty, Summerset Shadows) and what you must have done first isn't in the files; whether gaining those allies counts toward a later quest isn't shown
when Vex and Delvin start offering the radiant jobs isn't in the files; the Meet the Family journal points to them, which suggests they come after it
what starts Meet the Family isn't in the files; it reads like a follow-on to joining the guild
Paid in Full is filed with the miscellaneous quests; whether it needs Thieves Guild standing isn't shown

the three Nightingale powers aren't tied to each choice directly in the files; which version of the Nightingale armor you get and which Amulet of Articulation isn't shown; what Prowler's Profit and the Nightingale Shadow Perk do in LoreRim isn't in the files
A Chance Arrangement's script also hands out a pickpocket boost; whether it stays isn't shown

lines.name: The Dark Brotherhood
lines.about: The Dark Brotherhood is a guild of assassins based in a Sanctuary in the pine forest near Falkreath, and its story has you take contracts across Skyrim that build toward one great contract. The main story runs thirteen quests, from Innocence Lost to Hail Sithis!, with many side contracts around it.

getIn.how: Go to his house (LoreRim leaves the door unlocked) and talk to him; he asks you to kill Grelod the Kind, the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.

order.what: Aventus Aretino asks you to kill Grelod the Kind, the headmistress of Honorhall Orphanage.
order.where: Windhelm and Honorhall Orphanage in Riften

order.quest: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...
order.what: Once the Brotherhood uses the Dawnstar Sanctuary, you pay Delvin Mallory in the Ragged Flagon to refit it.
order.where: the Ragged Flagon in Riften and the Dawnstar Sanctuary
order.needs: The Brotherhood has moved into the Dawnstar Sanctuary

order.what: You settle a dispute between the jester Cicero, stuck with a broken cart, and the farmer Vantus Loreius.
Astrid holds you captive in an abandoned shack and tells you to kill one of her three captives.
order.needs: Kill Grelod the Kind in Innocence Lost

order.what: Astrid welcomes you, and Nazir gives you your first contracts.
order.where: the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath
order.needs: Join the Brotherhood in With Friends Like These...

order.what: Astrid sends you to Muiri in Markarth, who wants the bandit Alain Dufont dead.
order.where: The Hag's Cure in Markarth and Raldbthar, The Pale

order.what: Astrid asks you to hide in the Night Mother's coffin and listen in on Cicero.
order.where: the Night Mother's chamber in the Sanctuary

order.what: Astrid lets you meet the client, Amaund Motierre, in Volunruud.
You kill Vittoria Vici at her wedding reception in Solitude.
order.where: outside the Temple of the Divines in Solitude

order.what: Gabriella gives you the contract on Gaius Maro of the Penitus Oculatus, who is touring the cities of Skyrim.
order.where: the Penitus Oculatus Outpost at Dragon Bridge and the cities on his route

order.what: Cicero has turned on the Family, and Astrid sends you after him.
Festus Krex sends you to find and kill the chef known as the Gourmet.
order.where: Understone Keep in Markarth and Nightgate Inn

order.what: Posing as the Gourmet, you go to Castle Dour for the great contract.
You return to find the Sanctuary under attack by the Penitus Oculatus.
order.where: the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary near Falkreath

order.what: The Night Mother tells you the contract with Amaund Motierre must still be completed.
order.where: the Bannered Mare in Whiterun, the Katariah at Solitude, and Volunruud

order.what: Only if you kill Astrid in the shack: you report it, and Commander Maro asks you to wipe out the Sanctuary.
order.where: the Penitus Oculatus Outpost at Dragon Bridge and the Sanctuary
order.needs: Kill Astrid in With Friends Like These...

order.what: Only if you break the Sanctuary's rules: you must pay Nazir a fine before any more Brotherhood business.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the beggar Narfi in the ruins just outside Ivarstead, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the ex-miller Ennodius Papius, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the mine boss Beitild, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the vampire Hern, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the bard Lurbuk, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill Deekus at the shipwreck on the northern coast, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the Khajiit merchant Ma'randru-jo, who travels with Ri'saad's caravan, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the archer Anoriath, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the old servant Agnis; Nazir warns your side in the civil war may affect whether you can get in, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the wizard Maluril, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill Helvard, the Housecarl of Falkreath, then report back to him for payment.
A side contract from Nazir: kill the pirate captain Safia, then report back to him for payment.
order.where: the Red Wave at the Solitude docks

lines.name: The Civil War
lines.about: The Civil War is the fight for Skyrim between the Imperial Legion, based in Castle Dour in Solitude, and the Stormcloaks, based in the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm. You join one side, pass its test, recover the Jagged Crown and carry a message to Whiterun, then fight hold campaigns, war missions and city battles.

getIn.where: inside Castle Dour in Solitude from 6 in the morning; from about 7 to 11 at night she walks the city
getIn.how: Talk to Rikke about joining the Legion; to join the Stormcloaks instead, talk to Galmar Stone-Fist in the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm (Joining the Stormcloaks).

order.what: A journal note pointing you to join the Imperial Legion; you settle it by talking to Legate Rikke.
A journal note pointing you to join the Stormcloaks; you settle it by talking to Galmar Stone-Fist.

Galmar tests you by sending you to kill an ice wraith on Serpentstone Isle, then you take the oath.

Stormcloak side: Galmar takes you to Korvanjund to claim the Jagged Crown before the Legion does.

lines.name: Vigilant

Its first act runs eleven quests, from Vigilant of Stendarr to The Landing, followed by a vampire hunt under Windhelm, the Coldharbour memories, and bounties and radiant hunts on the side.

who hands out the bounties and the Radiance jobs, and whether you must have joined first, isn't in the files
what starts Empty Cells, the Coldharbour memories, Broken Horns, Maggot, Child of Oblivion and Successor isn't in the files; Empty Cells probably follows the first act

most rewards are properties on quest scripts, not confirmed hand-overs; Lamae's Kin and Mark of Molag Bal may be given or lifted by several quests, and spells like Force, Eye of Madness and Vampire Form may be effects used in a scene rather than rewards
whether Lamae Bal dies in The Blood Matron, and what happens to Thingol in Remnants, isn't in the files
